items.english: (It is obvious) that this can occur only for a finite number of argument values.

items.english: It follows that in this case the series always converges to (f(x+0)+f(x-0))/2, provided this value is finite.
It remains only to investigate in which cases the contribution of the places where the function becomes infinite eventually becomes infinitely small as n increases.
This investigation is also not settled.
